What each side argued

Rider advocate15 claim(s), 12 kept

  1. The deviation is established on this trip's own trace.

    Read the whole claim

    gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 18.2 km against a booked optimal of 14.0 km, an excess of 4.2 km — 30.0% of optimal — so both POL-RD-01 tests pass: the excess is greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing field, so the same 18.2 km appearing on the trip record is not cited for the threshold test. Disclosure: the trace is impaired, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and the following claims deal with that impairment rather than hide it.

    EV-GPS-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-01

  2. The one impairment cannot absorb the excess.

    Read the whole claim

    It is a single 100.0 s sampling gap (19:39:44 to 19:41:24) whose bounding fixes are 1.01 km apart, on a trace with 94.5% coverage, 174 fixes and 30.3 minutes of running. POL-RD-07(i) requires the impaired stretch to be read as the straight line between its bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver — and a 1.01 km stretch cannot account for a 4.2 km excess. The gap changes how one stretch is measured; it does not change whether a deviation exists.

    EV-GPS-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-07, POL-RD-01Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-02826 at weight_multiplier 0.6 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW

  3. The impaired trace does not stand alone.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-07(ii) allows a deviation to be corroborated by a counterparty_statement admitting the route, and the driver's own statement on this dispute, filed by the DRIVER on 2026-08-19, is 'Navigation rerouted me.' That is the counterparty admitting the vehicle did not follow the planned route — an account independent of the trace, never withdrawn and never qualified. The rider does not rely on trip_record.actual_distance_km for this purpose, because POL-RD-01 identifies it as a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement and therefore not independent. The corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) requires is present, and the trace's impairment (weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW) is cured by it.

    EV-TRIP-02826, EV-GPS-02826 · POL-RD-07, POL-RD-08

  4. No traffic advisory excuses the excess.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-03 exonerates only against a traffic_advisory that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, carries a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle reaching it, and is matched by a route that leaves the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after. EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload — and its own issue detail records that no advisory covers the Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd corridor in this window. The absence is itself citable: with no advisory on file the comparison cannot be run and POL-RD-03 is unavailable on this record.

    EV-ADVIS-02826-01, EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-03, POL-RD-13

  5. The driver's explanation discharges nothing.

    Read the whole claim

    Once the rider has shown a threshold-meeting excess, POL-RD-08 puts the burden on the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause; 'Navigation rerouted me' names no advisory, no road and no evidence ID, so it carries no weight. POL-RD-13 requires such an assertion to be tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, and because no advisory identifier is cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it — so this is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The driver is left with an unexplained 4.2 km.

    EV-ADVIS-02826-01, EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-08, POL-RD-13, POL-RD-10Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02826-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

  6. No rider-caused detour can be made out.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-04 exonerates only to the extent of a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log, timestamped before the vehicle left the optimal corridor or no more than three minutes after, and specific enough to act on. The chat log for TRP-02826 is COMPLETE and contains 0 messages, and trip_record.chat_message_count is 0, so there is no instruction, no waypoint_hint and nothing to corroborate. The rider asked for no detour and accepts none of the excess.

    EV-CHAT-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-04

  7. The baseline has not moved.

    Read the whole claim

    pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null on the trip record, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null, so no re-quote under POL-RD-05 exists and none may be derived; the booked 14.0 km optimal route is the correct baseline against which the trace is measured.

    EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-05

  8. The pooled-trip baseline does not apply.

    Read the whole claim

    trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is not in play and measuring excess against the booked 14.0 km optimal is the correct field. The rider's claim does not fail on a wrong-field ground.

    EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-12

  9. This is a metered trip, so the distance-refund route stays open.

    Read the whole claim

    fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and fare_breakdown.quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs the computation. The rider is not asking for money she never lost on a fixed price; she is asking for the difference between what was charged and what the optimal route costs.

    EV-FARE-02826 · POL-RD-11, POL-RD-02

  10. On POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic, not discretionary.

    Read the whole claim

    recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the surge_multiplier of 1.0 recorded on the fare_breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, = 20.42; there is no ERP on the optimal route, no surcharge and no waiting-time fee to add. charged_total is 26.73, so the refund is 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 as 6.35. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor, and at 23.6% of charged_total it is far below the 90% share that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND — so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35 to the rider.

    EV-FARE-02826 · POL-RD-02

  11. No pass-through charge may be added on top.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-09(1) forbids stacking off-route ERP on the POL-RD-02 figure, and nothing is due in any event: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and airport_surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. The 6.35 is the distance and time difference alone, and no line of the ledger is counted twice.

    EV-FARE-02826, EV-TRIP-02826 · POL-RD-09

  12. The rider's initial burden is discharged.

    Read the whole claim

    TRP-02826 is the trip identifier carried on the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown, the pickup timestamp matches across them, and the excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. The rider's own profile raises no corroboration bar: deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 condition of four or more claims with one or fewer substantiated is not met, and in any event the measured excess of 30.0% is not below 30%. (EV-GPS-02826 is impaired at weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and is cited here only for the excess it measures.)

    EV-RPROF-02826, EV-TRIP-02826, EV-GPS-02826, EV-FARE-02826 · POL-RD-08

  13. Only the profile counters the policy names may ground a finding.

    Read the whole claim

    The driver's prior_deviation_flags (1) and prior_no_show_flags (2) are lifetime counters and near-synonyms of the trailing-window fields the clauses actually name, and substituting one for the other is forbidden by POL-GEN-01; rating, account age and cancellation rate on either profile are context only. The rider seeks no finding from any profile field, and none of them decides this trip — the trace and the ledger do.

    EV-DPROF-02826, EV-RPROF-02826 · POL-GEN-01

  14. Even on the least favourable reading, the rider does not end up carrying the disputed charge.

    Read the whole claim

    If the panel were to hold that the impaired trace has no independent corroboration, POL-RD-10(3) governs and the ruling is ESCALATE: terminal, no monetary outcome, and the disputed amount held rather than collected under POL-GEN-03. To the rider and to the driver: this dispute cannot be settled on the record as it stands, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves now — the SGD 26.73 charged on TRP-02826 (EV-FARE-02826) is held rather than collected or refunded, and the SGD 11.00 contested is not awarded. What the evidence shows. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02826) records a METERED trip charged SGD 26.73: base fare 3.80 + distance 10.50 + time 5.32 + platform fee 0.80, with surge multiplier 1.0 read from that same artifact, and no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge and no waiting fee. The booked optimal route is 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02826). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02826) measures 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, 30.0% of optimal — which would pass both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). Why the trace cannot carry that finding. The trace is impaired twice over. The admissibility pre-pass tagged it IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and it is impaired for policy purposes too: it contains a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:39:44 to 19:41:24), above the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone and must be corroborated by an independent source. No weighted independent source exists here: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02826) holds 0 messages; the fare breakdown records no ERP gantries and 0.00 of tolls; and the 18.2 km on the trip record is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, not an independent derivation. The rider's submission that the driver's one-line statement 'Navigation rerouted me' is the 'counterparty_statement admitting the route' is not accepted: it names no road, junction or segment, it places the vehicle on no corridor the optimal route does not use, and it asserts a cause (the navigation) rather than admitting the route; the driver's contrary submission on that point succeeds. With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration, POL-RD-10(3) fires and the case escalates. The same result follows even if that statement were read as an admission. It carries no weight_multiplier and so cannot lift the confidence cap: the excess is carried only by the impaired trace at weight 0.6, so confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) would fire. Escalation is terminal either way and replaces any money outcome. The driver's navigation excuse. No advisory covers this window: EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload). POL-RD-03 cannot be run in either direction, and under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; because no advisory identifier was cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The rider's arithmetic, recorded but not awarded. Were the deviation established, POL-RD-02 would run: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the 1.0 surge on the fare breakdown + 0.80 = 20.42, giving a refund of 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND, above the 0.50 de minimis and at 23.6% of the charge well below the 90% full-refund share. I record that figure and do not award it. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09: there is no ERP, toll or surcharge line, so there is no double-count and no billing-integrity correction. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 287 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not be substituted for it. What would resolve it. A POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry record placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — together with the traffic advisory for the disputed window, which the bundle lacks. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04, or ask that a person decide the dispute.

That is also impairment for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a), so the deviation may not rest on the trace alone. The driver's statement, 'Navigation rerouted me', is a counterparty statement admitting the vehicle was rerouted, and I accept it as the independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) allows, so POL-RD-07(iii) does not by itself force escalation. But corroboration that a reroute happened does not repair the distance measurement: the 4.2 km excess is carried by EV-GPS-02826 at weight 0.60, and nothing else carries it independently. The 18.2 km on the trip record is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded copy of the same trace measurement that may not be cited for the threshold test; the fare ledger's distance comes from the same trace; and a counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier, so it can neither lower nor raise the cap. Under POL-GEN-02(2) my confidence cannot exceed 0.60, which is below the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) requires a human reviewer. If the driver's statement were read as too thin to corroborate, POL-RD-10(3) would require escalation on the same facts. Either way the disputed SGD 11.00 is held rather than collected or refunded. The parties' other points. The driver's traffic explanation carries no weight: no traffic advisory covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0), and POL-RD-13 tests such an explanation against the advisory and nothing else; because the driver named no advisory ID, the gap in the bundle is not by itself a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The rider's position is otherwise sound on the facts: the chat log holds no messages (EV-CHAT-02826), so POL-RD-04 finds no rider instruction, and no pickup or dropoff was amended, so POL-RD-05 leaves the 14.0 km baseline untouched. RYDE_X is not a pooled product, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. Nothing falls to be corrected under POL-RD-09 — no ERP gantries, no tolls, no airport surcharge — and there is no billing-integrity finding. No repeat-deviation pattern is established (0 deviation flags over 287 completed trips in the last 90 days), so there is no POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. Neither profile decides anything: POL-GEN-01 permits only the trailing-window counters the clauses name, and the lifetime counters (prior_deviation_flags, prior_no_show_flags) are context only. POL-GEN-05 does not arise, because with no monetary effect there is nothing to execute. What would resolve it. A measurement of this trip that does not depend on the 0.60-weight trace: a continuous GPS export covering 19:39:44 to 19:41:24, or a platform-derived distance or ERP gantry record that is not copied from this trace. On that evidence the SGD 6.35 (or the correct figure) can be ruled. Until then the fare stands as charged and the case goes to human review under POL-RD-10.

The judge's explanation, verbatim

To the rider and to the driver: this dispute cannot be settled on the record as it stands, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves now — the SGD 26.73 charged on TRP-02826 (EV-FARE-02826) is held rather than collected or refunded, and the SGD 11.00 contested is not awarded. What the evidence shows. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02826) records a METERED trip charged SGD 26.73: base fare 3.80 + distance 10.50 + time 5.32 + platform fee 0.80, with surge multiplier 1.0 read from that same artifact, and no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge and no waiting fee. The booked optimal route is 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02826). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02826) measures 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, 30.0% of optimal — which would pass both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). Why the trace cannot carry that finding. The trace is impaired twice over. The admissibility pre-pass tagged it IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and it is impaired for policy purposes too: it contains a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:39:44 to 19:41:24), above the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone and must be corroborated by an independent source. No weighted independent source exists here: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02826) holds 0 messages; the fare breakdown records no ERP gantries and 0.00 of tolls; and the 18.2 km on the trip record is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, not an independent derivation. The rider's submission that the driver's one-line statement 'Navigation rerouted me' is the 'counterparty_statement admitting the route' is not accepted: it names no road, junction or segment, it places the vehicle on no corridor the optimal route does not use, and it asserts a cause (the navigation) rather than admitting the route; the driver's contrary submission on that point succeeds. With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration, POL-RD-10(3) fires and the case escalates. The same result follows even if that statement were read as an admission. It carries no weight_multiplier and so cannot lift the confidence cap: the excess is carried only by the impaired trace at weight 0.6, so confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) would fire. Escalation is terminal either way and replaces any money outcome. The driver's navigation excuse. No advisory covers this window: EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload). POL-RD-03 cannot be run in either direction, and under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; because no advisory identifier was cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The rider's arithmetic, recorded but not awarded. Were the deviation established, POL-RD-02 would run: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the 1.0 surge on the fare breakdown + 0.80 = 20.42, giving a refund of 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND, above the 0.50 de minimis and at 23.6% of the charge well below the 90% full-refund share. I record that figure and do not award it. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09: there is no ERP, toll or surcharge line, so there is no double-count and no billing-integrity correction. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 287 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not be substituted for it. What would resolve it. A POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry record placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — together with the traffic advisory for the disputed window, which the bundle lacks. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04, or ask that a person decide the dispute. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

POL-RD-07(i) requires the impaired stretch to be read as the straight line between its bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver — and a 1.01 km stretch cannot account for a 4.2 km excess.
